headline: Approved 15 of 16 maintainer applications and removed two candidates from a police officers list; tabled internal applications to a later special meeting.
summary: Members removed two candidates from a police officers list and added one name to a library branch manager applicants list. They approved four requests to fill positions and 15 of 16 maintainer applications. Internal applications and eligibility lists for four positions were tabled until a later special meeting.
decisions: Tabled approval of the CSC Special Meeting Minutes from 9.25.26, unanimously.
Approved adding Ms. Stephanie Smith to the Library Branch Manager applicants list, unanimously.
Approved removing two candidates from Certified Police Officers List #26-17 per code (F), unanimously.
Approved all four requests to fill (HEO Back Up Operator, Truck Driver, Night Custodian, Maintainer I- Tree Crew), unanimously.
Tabled internal applications and eligibility list certification for four positions until the special meeting scheduled for October 8th, 2026, unanimously.
Approved 15 of 16 additional maintainer applications; one applicant did not meet the Connecticut driver's license requirement, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Lobo made a motion to table the minutes until they can be amended to include the new Request to Fill removing the Firefighters App as a recruitment tool. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Lobo made a motion to add Ms. Stephanie Smith to the Library Branch Manager applicants list. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to remove the two (2) candidates from the Certified Police Officers List # 26-17 per code (F). Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Commissioner Lobo motioned to approve all four Requests To Fill, HEO Back up Operator, Truck Driver, Night Custodian, and Maintainer I- Tree Crew. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Commissioner Lobo motioned to table Action Items 3 and 4 until the special meeting scheduled for October 8th, 2026, so the Commission can review the completed internal applications and job descriptions for all four positions. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.

Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve 15 out of 16 applications, per one (1) applicant does not meet the requirement of having a Connecticut Drivers License. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Civil Service Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
9:00 AM, October 6, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 
 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, Helen Ward, Andrea Lobo 
Staff in attendance: Director of Human Resources, Lee Palmer, Administrative Assistant, J. 
Susy Diaz-Callands. Deputy Chief of Staff, Alexa Panayotakis,  
Officer Cotto, Detective Palma and Lieutenant Mansfield.  
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
Review and approval of the CSC Special Meeting Minutes from 9.25.26  
 Commissioner Lobo made a motion to table the minutes until they can be amended to 
include the new Request to Fill removing the Firefighters App as a recruitment tool. 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
Motion passes unanimously.  
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 None.  
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 None.  
6. ACTION ITEMS   
 Commissioner Lobo made a motion to add Ms. Stephanie Smith to the Library Branch 
Manager applicants list. 
Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
Motion passes unanimously.   
 1. Correspondence from Chief Reynolds to remove two (2) candidates from the  Certified 
Police officers list #26-17 per code (F).  
       
  Commissioner Andrews motioned to remove the two (2) candidates from the Certified 
Police Officers List # 26-17 per code (F).  
Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion.  
Motion passes unanimously.  
 2. RTF 
• HEO Back Up Operator
• Truck Driver  
• Night Custodian  
• Maintainer 1- Tree Crew 
 
       
   
Commissioner Lobo motioned to approve all four Requests To Fill, HEO Back up 
Operator, Truck Driver, Night Custodian, and Maintainer I- Tree Crew.  
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
  
 3. Review and approve the following internal applications: 
• HEO Back Up Operator 
• Truck Driver 
• Night Custodian 
• Maintainer 1 - Tree Crew 
 
       
  Commissioner Lobo motioned to table Action Items 3 and 4 until the special meeting 
scheduled for October 8th, 2026, so the Commission can review the completed 
internal applications and job descriptions for all four positions.  
Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
The motion passed unanimously.  
 4. Certification of the following eligibility lists:  
• List #26-20 HEO Back up Operator 
• List  #26-21 Truck Driver 
• List # 26-22 Night Custodian 
• List # 26-23 Maintainer 1- Tree Crew 
• List # 26-24 Branch Library Manager 
 
       
  Commissioner Lobo motioned to table Action Items 3 and 4 until the special meeting 
scheduled for October 8th, 2026, so the Commission can review the completed 
internal applications and job descriptions for all four positions.  
Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
The motion passed unanimously.  
 5. Review and approve sixteen (16) additional maintainer applications. 
       
  Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve 15 out of 16 applications, per one (1) 
applicant does not meet the requirement of having a Connecticut Drivers License.  
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously.  
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 None.  
8. REPORTS
None. 
9. OLD BUSINESS   
 None. 
10. NEW BUSINESS   
 None. 
11. ADJOURNMENT   
 Commissioner Lobo motioned to adjourn. 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion passed unanimously, meeting adjourned at 9:39 a.m.
